headline: Osorio Realty LLC request for a ceiling height variance at 192 Columbus Avenue during building renovation.
summary: Osorio Realty LLC, the applicant and owner, asks for a dimensional variance from State Building Code Section 1208.2, Minimum Ceiling Height. It proposes a ceiling height of 7ft 2in (86in), where 7ft 6in (90in) is required.
items: Dimensional variance for ceiling height at 192 Columbus Avenue, Osorio Realty LLC
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860
plain_text:
City of Pawtucket
Board of Appeals
Meeting Agenda
Monday, November 30, 2026 at 7:15 P.M.
Pawtucket Municipal Annex
100 Freight Street
Pawtucket, RI 02860
Zoning Board of Appeals.
Osorio Realty LLC applicant and owner of the property located at 192 Columbus
Avenue further identified as Tax Assessor’s Plat 33 Lot 790 is requesting a dimensional
variance from the State of Rhode Island Building Code Section 1208.2 Minimum Ceiling
Height. The applicant is proposing a minimum ceiling height of 7ft 2in (86in) where a
minimum ceiling height of 7ft 6in (90in) is required in the renovation of the building on
the property.
                                                       Nathan T. Luciano
                                                       Chairperson
                                                       Board of Appeals
The Pawtucket Municipal Annex is accessible to people with disabilities. Individuals requesting
